title: Homework document input
description: Mirrors HomeworkPdfDownloadProps after the app has resolved class and teacher names.

body.description: Teacher-authored rich HTML (Quill). Sanitised before rendering.

due_date.description: Date or date-time; printed en-US long, or "No due date".

created_at.description: Printed en-US long, or an em dash.

className.description: Resolved class name; empty prints an em dash.

teacherName.description: Resolved teacher name; empty prints an em dash.

answerLines.description: writing-space only: number of ruled lines (default 14).
